slides.title: M13 one-series column, North and East highlighted: legend names the series

chart.alt: Average wait in minutes per terminal; North and East are above the 30 minute target

slides.notes: M13 slide 1. One-series column chart with two highlighted columns and a bottom legend. Look at the legend under the chart: one entry, 'Wait', not four category names. The highlighted columns are North and East. Edit Chart Data: column C holds the highlighted values.

slides.title: M13 one-series bar, North highlighted: legend says Wait only

chart.alt: Wait per terminal; North is the longest at 42 minutes

slides.notes: M13 slide 2. One-series horizontal bar chart, North highlighted, legend at the bottom, axis titles and a dotted target line. Look at the legend: one entry 'Wait'. North's bar keeps its place in the top row.

slides.title: M13 one-series line with markers, March highlighted: legend says Visits

chart.alt: Monthly visits in thousands; March dipped before the spring rise

slides.notes: M13 slide 3. One-series line chart with markers, the March point highlighted, legend on the right. Look at the legend: one entry 'Visits'. The line is unbroken; March has its own marker.

slides.title: M64 data labels on one line: '31 Self-serve' at the line ends

chart.alt: Cumulative bookings by segment with markers

slides.notes: M64 slide 4. Two small stacked line charts side by side with the series names at the line ends. Look at the end labels on the right of each chart: '31 Self-serve', '36 Mid-market' stay on one line each, not broken in two.

slides.title: M64 data labels 'Terminal: value' and slice names stay on one line
slides.notes: M64 slide 5. A two-series column chart labeled 'North: 42' inside the column ends beside a pie with slice names. Look at every data label: one line each.

slides.title: M66 dashboard: charts below their heading row keep the preview's plot
slides.notes: M66 slide 6. Dashboard with two metrics over a column chart (axis titles) and a bar chart (value-axis title). Look at the top of each chart's plot: the first gridline sits half a text line under the chart's top edge as in the OPF preview, not right under it; axis titles keep their room.

slides.title: M66 small column chart under a top legend: label of the tallest column below the legend
slides.notes: M66 slide 7. Small two-series column chart (no value axis, every column labeled) with the legend at the top. Look at the label '42' on the tallest column: it stands under the legend row, not on it.

slides.title: M66 three narrow small column charts: top labels clear of the chart tops
slides.notes: M66 slide 8. Three narrow one-series column charts side by side, each with a caption above (the header row). Look at the tallest column of each: its value label sits under the caption, not over the caption's text.

slides.title: M66 small bar chart: the longest bar keeps room for its label

chart.alt: Wait per terminal; East is longest

slides.notes: M66 slide 9. Small horizontal bar chart (no value axis) whose longest bar is last. Look at the right end of the East bar: its value label '47' is fully inside the chart frame.

slides.title: M14 pie, legend right, EMEA highlighted: white lines separate every slice
slides.notes: M14 slide 10. Pie with legend on the right and one highlighted slice (EMEA). Look between APAC and AMER: both are muted in one color, and a separator line in the background color divides them. The pie's size and position match the OPF preview (not about a tenth larger and higher).

slides.title: M14 doughnut, four muted segments of one color: separators between all

chart.alt: APAC is the second largest region

slides.notes: M14 slide 11. Doughnut with five segments, one highlighted (APAC), legend at the bottom. Look at the four muted segments: each is separated from its neighbors by a line in the background color.

slides.title: M14 pie with outside labels and no legend: plot square as in the preview
slides.notes: M14 slide 12. Pie with category and value labels outside the slices, no legend, no highlight. Look at the pie's size and position against the OPF preview: same circle, labels outside it.

slides.title: M14 pie beside a table, highlight: square plot beside the rows
slides.notes: M14 slide 13. Pie with a highlighted slice beside a table of the same regions. Look at the pie: same size and place as in the preview, separators between the muted slices.

slides.title: M30 bar chart on a table's rows: one long word gets room for its label
slides.notes: M30 slide 14. Horizontal bar chart drawn on the rows of the table beside it; one category is the long word 'Internationalization'. Look at the category label column: 'Internationalization' is whole, and the bars start where the OPF preview's do (up to 40% of the chart for the labels).

slides.title: M11 bar chart on a table's rows with a category axis title: title beside its labels
slides.notes: M11 slide 15. Same bar chart on the table's rows, with a category axis title 'Workstream' and value title 'Weeks'. Look at the rotated 'Workstream' title left of the category labels: it does not overlap them.

slides.title: M11 bar chart on a table's rows, short names, both axis titles
slides.notes: M11 slide 16. Bar chart on the rows of a two-row table, both axis titles. Look at the 'Prototype' title left of 'Prototype A' and 'Prototype B': no overlap.
